title: Almost Sharp Equivalence between Approximate Message Passing and Low-Degree Polynomials
summary: We prove a sharp lower bound for growing-degree polynomial estimation in the symmetric rank-one matrix estimation problem. The observation is \[ \boldsymbol{Y}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \boldsymbolθ \boldsymbolθ^{\top}+\boldsymbol{W}, \] where the coordinates of $\boldsymbolθ$ are independent with a common, fixed sub-Gaussian distribution $π_Θ$ satisfying $\mathbb E[Θ]\neq0$, and $\boldsymbol{W}$ is symmetric with independent standard Gaussian upper-triangular entries.
